description: Dependent native warp/wave shuffle chains for XOR, indexed, up, and down intrinsics. One final integer store per thread. Emits raw GPU event and host times; logical shuffle rate is derived downstream, not an isolated instruction latency or device peak.

scaling_param.name: ops_per_thread
scaling_param.description: Number of shuffle operations each thread performs per kernel invocation

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks; default one block measures its dependent chains, without establishing a device peak.

non_scaling_params.name: threads_per_block
non_scaling_params.description: Threads per block; must be a positive multiple of the selected device native warp/wave width and within its launch limits.

non_scaling_params.name: shuffle_variant
non_scaling_params.description: One shuffle variant per sweep entry. The binary also accepts all for a manual four-variant run.

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Run the clock/cache warmer before each timed launch. Its achieved clock and cache effects require target qualification; false times the kernel as-is.
